prompt:
Instrumental only, no vocals, no voice, no lyrics. Length: 2 minutes 50 seconds.
Epic hybrid trailer music with drift phonk drums: massive braams, taiko ensembles, staccato strings and brass, a dark cowbell lead, distorted 808 bass. For a dramatic short film on the rise and fall of human civilizations over 2,000 years.
Strict steady tempo, 130 BPM, 4/4, C minor. Every beat clear; the picture cuts on the beat.
Many accents: orchestral hits and taiko on the downbeats, stutter edits, drum fills and swells into every new section, booming impacts every 8 beats. Changing sections, never a flat loop.

[0:00 - 0:06] Massive hits on every beat.
[0:06 - 0:09] Reverse swell and tape-stop rewind, then silence.
[0:09 - 0:45] Mysterious, tense build: pulsing strings, ticking percussion, phonk beat in half energy.
[0:45 - 1:48] Full power: phonk drums plus taiko and brass, heroic and aggressive.
[1:48 - 2:12] Solemn requiem: no drums, low choir, cello, a tolling bell.
[2:12 - 2:32] Faster, brighter, unstoppable: double-time drums, soaring strings, the climax.
[2:32 - 2:44] Calm piano.
[2:44 - 2:50] Final braam, ring out.

description.en: Epic hybrid trailer music with drift-phonk drums: braams, taiko ensembles, staccato strings and brass, a dark cowbell lead and distorted 808 bass; hits on the downbeats and booming impacts every 8 beats. 130 BPM, C minor.
description.zh: 史诗混合预告片配乐加漂移 Phonk 鼓：Braam 低音号角、太鼓群、断奏弦乐和铜管、暗色牛铃主旋律、失真 808；重拍上有打击，每 8 拍一次轰鸣。130 BPM，C 小调。

metadataBasis: description, style, tempo, key, moods and energy are prompt intent (instrumental prompt; some prompts ask for a wordless choir); duration is measured; no automated audio review
